title: Antes de la conquista
goal: Read how historians actually know what they know about the pre-Columbian world, from surviving Maya codices to a friar who copied down the Popol Vuh.

items: Explain why only four original Maya codices survive today.
Describe two different ways historians can date the pre-Columbian past.
Explain how the Popol Vuh survived to the present day.
Recognise why historians rarely have a single definitive proof.
Use formal connectors like 'a pesar de' and 'a raíz de' to weigh evidence.
I can explain why only four original Maya codices survive today.
